{{Top|leg}}
An '''energy baffler''' or '''energy damper''' was a [[Sensor jammer/Legends|jamming]] device that masked energy emissions from installations<ref name="TotSB">{{WEGCite|story=Tales of the Smoking Blaster|book=Star Wars Gamemaster Handbook|stext=Tales of the ''Smoking Blaster''}}</ref> of [[Starship/Legends|starships]].<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> [[Yorseg's base]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Carz]] employed elaborate energy bafflers as its main defense.<ref name="TotSB" />
